description: This file declares the DeviceRegistry class responsible for managing device registrations within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes methods for registering, unregistering, retrieving devices, and listing device IDs, utilizing smart pointers for device handling.

classes.name: DeviceRegistry
classes.description: A class that manages the registration and lookup of devices, using a map of device IDs to device handlers.

methods.name: RegisterDevice
methods.description: Registers a device with a given ID and device handler.

methods.name: UnRegisterDevice
methods.description: Unregisters a device by its ID.

methods.name: GetDevice
methods.description: Retrieves a shared pointer to the device handler associated with the given device ID.

methods.name: ListDeviceIds
methods.description: Returns a list of all registered device IDs.
